title: Escaping the Filter Bubble: Evaluating Electroencephalographic Theta Band Synchronization as Indicator for Selective Exposure in Online News Reading
reasoning: The paper is an experimental study in Human-Computer Interaction that investigates physiological indicators (EEG and eye-tracking) of selective exposure in humans. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics; the discussion of ethics is limited to the implications of future bias-aware systems.
